how_measured: Each object's ZIP central directory was read by ranged request — a few kilobytes out of 12.1 GB — and the region code taken from the .shp member name (LSMD_CONT_LDREG_<code>_<yyyymm>).
why_this_file_exists: The prefix holds the whole country twice: 17 objects at province granularity and 255 at district granularity, and the object names (30563-N.zip) say nothing about which is which. Loading both would double every parcel. The district set is the one to load, because it is the finer grain and it is what silver.parcel_boundaries already holds.
consistency_check: The set of leading two digits across the 255 district codes equals the set of 17 province codes exactly, which is what makes them two coverings of one country rather than two different datasets.
